role: Renders an EntityCow: the quadruped cow model at the cow texture, no behaviour of its own beyond texture binding.
scope_reason: Cows are in the gated animal spawn lists and the mob scenes compare their pixels.

members.name: RenderCow
members.note: model construction; the native model is model_cow (quadruped with horns and udder)

notes: The cow's doRender is the inherited RenderLiving chain (RendererLivingEntity pass loop) that raster_mobs.c implements once for all quadruped mobs; model_cow carries the geometry.
